question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"vacantly"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When there is **an underlying sense of emptiness** in an **activity, the word vacantly is employed**.
 
• **Vacantly **means **showing no interest or mental activity.**
